integrity: The conclusion and uniform expansion have an analytic proof; nine finite numerical checks are supplementary. Previous spectral and resolvent methods are expressly credited.
scientific_limitations: Applies to inverse-adjacency-Perron SIS linearization on two fixed-degree regular induced communities. It does not establish finite stochastic SIS persistence or nonlinear endemic prevalence. Degree is fixed while a single bridge endpoint has growing total degree. Priority remains literature-bounded.
title: Universal hub-bridge amplification and a local-triangle correction in two-community epidemic thresholds
